published.citation: Wallack et al. 2019, dayside brightness temperature at 4.5 µm, 1087 +91 -102 K, from an eclipse depth of 265 +68 -72 ppm: 1087 +/- 102 K, https://arxiv.org/abs/1908.00014

temperature.note: Its day side's brightness temperature is measured in secondary eclipse at 4.5 µm (Spitzer IRAC) and nobody has imaged it, so the color is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
temperature.chosen: the one band with a detected eclipse; the larger of its two errors is kept
